partner.scope: same-sign two-square overlap with arbitrary measurable active/environment translations and residual environment phase

required_fixed_source.completed_result_used: Theorem A: in dimension three with all |eigenvalues|>=sigma, density <= 6 sqrt(pi)/sigma, affine terms allowed
required_fixed_source.application: A_*=[[2,1,0],[1,2,0],[0,0,-1]], spectrum {3,1,-1}, gives 6 sqrt(pi) uniformly on the finite/countable comb active laws

proved_results.statement: For active positive subdensities of caps L_W,L_U and arbitrary independent environment finite measure of mass m_Z, the pushforward by a(W+Phi(U,Z))^2+d(U+theta(Z))^2+R(Z), ad>0, has density cap pi L_W L_U m_Z/sqrt(|ad|).
An active square-carrier submeasure can have arbitrarily small mass while W^2+U^2 retains density height pi; no universal positive active-mass exponent is available at the Beta endpoint.

There are cap-one probability densities f_R with ||f_R||_p->0 for every fixed finite p>1 while p_{W^2+U_R^2}=pi on a shrinking positive interval; finite-p collision energy cannot replace the active L-infinity cap.

next_step: Derive from bare s_3(A)>=1, before active normalization, either a same-sign overlap representation with both active square carriers kept whole or a genuinely mass-homogeneous slope/volume/ridge/hub/grouped-bank/physical-triple exit.
